item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have expanded expulsions in a West Bank city, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing. In Gaza, IDF airstrikes have killed multiple Palestinians, including a child, and targeted two Hamas commanders and other terror operatives linked to financing. Hamas reported the killing of two of its security operatives during a mission in Gaza. Iran hosted regional powers for talks aimed at preventing fresh escalation in the wider conflict. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
